lines:
أحدهم لا يرى وآخر لا يسمع

headline:
صدرت لعبة BOMBANANA
على PS5 وعلى Xbox
label: متوفر الآن

angle.hook: BOMBANANA, a three-player co-op bomb defusal game where each player is a monkey that cannot see, hear or speak, is out on PS5 and Xbox
angle.why_now: the console versions launched 13 Nov 2026 at 09:00 UTC (13:00 Dubai) after the Steam release on 2 Sep
angle.what_it_means_here: UAE PS Store lists it at 39 AED (PS Plus members 20% off until 27 Nov); the UAE Xbox store shows 7.99 USD
angle.payoff: the information is split between the three players, so they must communicate with gestures and voice

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: PS Store UAE concept page read 13 Nov 09:37Z (release 2026-11-13T09:00Z, 39.00 AED, PS Plus 31.20 AED to 27 Nov, description), Xbox Store page (release 2026-11-13T09:00Z, USD 7.99), Steam page (released 2 Sep 2026); TARK press release reprint on Denfaminicogamer read
reel_check.SOURCE: age: first report 13 Nov 09:00Z, about 17 h at the slot
reel_check.SOUND: trailer own sound by the audio split; faster-whisper VAD on the whole trailer found no speech or singing
reel_check.PICTURE: official Steam trailer (the PS Store and Xbox store trailers are the same edit); cartoon art, nothing graphic
